summary: Frontend-only test of the new signature drag-to-reposition overlay on /letters (admin). The drag works: right, far-right, left, down, dragging in the layout modal, the existing numeric inputs, issuing the letter and checking the downloaded PDF all passed. A smoke test of the rest of the page (template pick, people picker search, table settings panel, draft save) also passed, and no page errors appeared. One UX problem: the handle's vertical start position is wrong. It sits about 30-40mm (about 100-130px at desktop size) BELOW the real signature text, often on top of the QR code.

ui_bugs.issue: The handle's vertical (Y) position is estimated with LETTER_MODEL.positions(), which does not follow the real body text. The handle always lands well below the signature (seen in every screenshot: signature at y≈478, handle at y≈605 in the scaled screenshot). After a right-align drag it covers the QR code. Users won't see that the red handle is 'over the signature'. Possible fix: return the signature's y/x (in mm) from the preview endpoint, for example in a response header like X-Sig-Y, and use that value instead of the estimate.

issues: The handle overlaps the QR code when signature_align is right, which looks confusing.

action_items: Fix the handle's Y position so it sits over the actual rendered signature (use the real y from the backend preview instead of the LETTER_MODEL estimate).
Optional: support touch by switching to pointer events (onPointerDown plus pointermove/pointerup) so the drag works on tablets and phones.
Optional: update dims on window resize (ResizeObserver). Right now dims only update on img onLoad, so the handle position goes stale if the layout is resized before the next preview refresh.

Optional: any drag, even a purely horizontal one, also writes gap_signature into layout, which counts as an extra override in the 'تخطيط الصفحة (n تعديل)' badge. Only write gap_signature when the vertical change is not zero.
critical_code_review_comments: SignatureDragOverlay.tsx: mouse events only (onMouseDown plus window mousemove/mouseup). There is no touch or pointer support, even though this is an Expo/RN-Web app.
SignatureDragOverlay.tsx: onLayoutChange runs on every mousemove. That is fine because of the 700ms debounce, but each move also re-renders the whole letters page. Acceptable for now.

Main and modal previews are passed layoutDefaults={...layoutDefaults, ...settings.layout}. If the selected letterhead has its own layout overrides (merged by the backend), the handle's starting X could differ from the rendered signature. It matched in this test with the general letterhead.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all functional checks passed; the only failure is the handle's vertical placement)

seed_data_creation: Issued letter 40/خ/26 (subject 'TEST_ سحب التوقيع PDF', recipient 'TEST_ مستلم'). Saved draft p-92 (template 'ترشيح طلاب للتدريب الميداني' + ' TEST_draft').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Measured results: dragging the main handle +200px moved the signature from left to center. +450px gave right (offset 0). -400px gave left. Dragging down 80px set gap_signature 16 to 40 (clamped). Dragging in the modal +220px gave right. Typing 20 in the offset input changed the preview and moved the handle. The issue payload's layout was {signature_align:'right', signature_offset:0, gap_signature:35}, and the downloaded PDF shows the signature right-aligned with the larger gap. The handle is not rendered before body text is typed (count 0). Issuing needs a recipient: use letter-rec-manual-mode + letter-rec-name.
